name: AliExpress secondary market listings for RTX 4090 48GB GDDR6X modded cards
notes: Observed 2026-10-11 on AliExpress marketplace for custom 48GB modded RTX 4090 GPUs (custom PCBs with 24GB-to-48GB clamshell GDDR6X memory mod, blower-style server coolers). Observed listing range: standalone modded cards advertised at $1,283.10 (entry price / partial tier) up to $3,510.48 and $3,695.24 for fully assembled blower workstation cards; multi-card server assemblies range up to $12,248.16. eBay queries for 48GB 4090 returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on 2026-10-11.
